_discovery.describe: Redis database explorer and management utility. Provides key-value browsing, search, and inspection capabilities. Supports all Redis data types (strings, lists, sets, hashes, sorted sets). Includes commands execution console and TTL management. Real-time key monitoring with pub/sub visualization. Fast queries (~100-500ms depending on key count). Useful for debugging application state, inspecting cache data, and managing Redis-backed workflows.
